programme.desc: 1950. Crime. Director: Felix E. Feist. Stars Lee J. Cobb, Jane Wyatt & John Dall. A homicide detective who witnesses his girlfriend kill her husband is assigned to the case, alongside his brother. [S]

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Logicians. 1971. Stars John Nolan & Irene Prador. A powerful antibiotic formula has been stolen near a school full of gifted teens. Are they responsible, and is computer technology to blame? [S]

programme.title: The Most Dangerous Game
programme.desc: 1932. Horror. Directors: Ernest B. Schoedsack & Irving Pichel. Stars Fay Wray, Joel McCrea, Leslie Banks & Robert Armstrong. Shipwrecked on an island, a hunter becomes the guest of Count Zaroff. [S]

programme.title: A Flight of Fancy 1967
programme.desc: 1967. A short film showing a plane journey with fascinating sights of the ocean below, snowy mountains and populated cities.

programme.title: Burke's Law

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Bow To A Master. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Della
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything. [S]

programme.title: There Was a Young Lady
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray & Sydney Tafler. A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient. [S]

programme.title: The Velvet Touch
programme.desc: 1948. Thriller. A police captain (Sydney Greenstreet) must solve the murder of a producer. Was it his ex or his ex ex? Stars Rosalind Russell, Leo Genn & Claire Trevor. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories

programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: House for Sale

programme.title: Danger UXB

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: The Partner. 1963. Directed by Gerard Glaister. Stars Yoko Tani, Guy Doleman & Ewan Roberts. Shady dealings put studio head Wayne Douglas and his new actress, Lin, in peril. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

programme.title: Crooks Anonymous
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Directed by Ken Annakin. Stars Leslie Phillips, Stanley Baxter & Wilfrid Hyde-White. Petty thief, Dandy Forsdyke, joins an unofficial organisation for reforming criminals. [S]

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Killian's Cut. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Peter Howell & Ann Lynn. A new employee at a jewellery shop interrupts a robbery and tries his luck by blackmailing the thieves - with disastrous results. [S]

programme.title: A Family At War

programme.title: Hannay

programme.title: Z-Cars

programme.title: Public Eye
